judge_context: Follow the trafficpolicy plugin pattern used by other features: API type with kubebuilder/CEL markers in traffic_policy_types.go, an IR type built in constructor.go, an apply step in traffic_policy_plugin.go that sets RouteAction.HashPolicy, and a mergeXxx function registered in MergeTrafficPolicies using the existing merge-origin helpers. Generated code (deepcopy, CRD YAML, applyconfigurations) should come from the repo codegen, not hand edits; dedup/sort logic belongs in small helpers shared by build and merge.

case_items.name: Multi-policy merge semantics
case_items.question: When several TrafficPolicies target the same route, does the merge union each array field with the higher-priority policy's entries first, dedupe by key, re-sort into canonical order (headers, cookies, queryParameters, filterState, sourceIp), keep the higher-priority sourceIp even when unset, honour disable, and record "consistentHash" in the existing TrafficPolicy merge metadata?

criteria.perfect: Dedicated merge function registered in MergeTrafficPolicies implementing all rules, using the existing merge-origin/metadata helpers like the other fields.
criteria.accept: Union and priority correct but one secondary rule missed (e.g. no re-sort after merge, or metadata key not recorded) and not caught by the golden test.
criteria.bad: Falls back to whole-field override (higher priority replaces lower), loses entries, or is not wired into MergeTrafficPolicies.

case_items.name: Empty spec and disable handling
case_items.name_zh: 空配置与 disable 处理
case_items.question: Is consistentHash: {} translated to exactly one sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false, does disable:true produce no hash policies and suppress ones inherited from broader policies, and is "disable with any other field" rejected at the API level (CEL/kubebuilder validation in the CRD) or in the plugin?

criteria.perfect: All three behaviours implemented; disable exclusivity enforced via CRD validation markers reflected in the generated CRD YAML.
criteria.accept: Empty and disable runtime behaviour correct, but disable exclusivity not validated (or only logged).
criteria.bad: Empty {} yields no hash policy, or disable does not suppress inherited policies.
